coverage.scope_note: Inventory maps the current BIR expression/statement/action enums and make_prim dispatch families, plus mandatory semantic matrix and audited BVI refusals. It does not claim complete compiler construct/library coverage or a closed refusal census of every loader error.
open_census_gates: Actual BSC library primitives beyond make_prim/Primitive::Other
Compiler Verilog accepted dynamic constructs and combinations
All BVI frontend-valid forms vs adapter refusals
Kernel system-task and BDPI effect family details
Minimal executable witness for every distinct cross-boundary interaction

toy_only_bounds.hidden: 4 public calls, R leaf steps, fixed parent artifact/contract bytes by construction
toy_only_bounds.repeated: 4*N public calls, 8*N leaf steps, one shared wrapper byte object
toy_only_bounds.independent_choices: 4*K guard evaluations over four changing vectors
